why: five OpenRouter credentials were supplied; the question was whether they carry usable capacity
freeModels: every free model tried (llama-3.3-70b, mistral-small-3.2, qwen3-30b, glm-4.5-air) returned 404 'This model is unavailable for free' on all five keys — the free tier is closed to these ids

paidModelVerified.note: verified through the app broker, not a direct call

defectFoundAndFixed: PROVIDER_RUNG_BUDGET_MS is 12s by default, which OpenRouter exceeded for LELU's full request; every turn timed out and then sat in cooldown. It is an existing env override, so no code changed.
harnessDefectFoundAndFixed: two browser processes shared one persistent profile and the second launch closed the first context mid-run ('Target page, context or browser has been closed'). The harness now launches a NEW browser process per phase and carries storage as exported storageState, which is also a truer fresh-process test.
remainingRefusal: in every attempt, the first turn of a session completes (create: real environment_compose dispatch) and subsequent turns report no available provider within ~3s, i.e. the provider is rate-limited into cooldown after the first request burst; the chain itself never failed
